description_en: Unbinds tags from cloud resources in a unified manner
description_zh: 为云资源统一解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center untag-cloud-resources --resource-type AppInstanceGroupId --resource-ids aig-0009 --tag-keys System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagCloudResources

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. A maximum of 50 resource IDs are supported. You do not need to specify this parameter when the resource type is tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表，最多支持50个。资源类型为租户ID时不需要指定
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags. System tags and custom tags are supported. You can specify up to 10 tags.

Enumerated values for system tags:
`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`: canary release tag.
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`: tag that prevents newly bound users in a delivery group from establishing connections
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。支持系统标签和自定义标签。最多可传入10个标签。

系统标签枚举值：
`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`：灰度标签
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`：阻止交付组新绑定用户建连的标签
parameters.name: tag_keys
